{{dateLine}} brings the New Moon in {{signTitle}}. Each New Moon is a new beginning: the sky goes dark, the month resets, and it is time to plant new seeds. Before the new cycle can take hold, the old one asks for a release, so clear the unfinished business and the draining distractions first. Intentions set now are seeds for the next six to eighteen months.
sky newmoon sign › aquarius
An Aquarius New Moon plants seeds for the future, yours and everyone's. Set intentions about community: the friendships you want, the groups worth your energy, the cause that needs your particular gifts. This is the Moon for the original idea, the experiment, the break from a status quo that no longer deserves your compliance. Challenge what threatens your freedom, and plant the invention you keep talking yourself out of. The caution is the fringe. Being different is your strength, but aloofness can quietly become isolation. Plant at least one seed that requires other people.
sky newmoon sign › aries
An Aries New Moon plants the year's boldest seeds. This is the New Moon for coming back into your own power: name what ignites you and make a clear plan to go get it. Aries rules the fresh start, so choose the beginning you have been postponing and give it a first step you can take this week. Watch the sign's shadow while you plant: impatience, impulsiveness, and the anger that flares when your needs go unspoken. Boundaries are part of the intention here. Wanting what you want is not selfish. Abandoning yourself to be accepted is the real cost.
sky newmoon sign › cancer
A Cancer New Moon plants emotional seeds. Ruled by the Moon herself, this is the reset for your inner life: set the emotional tone you want for the cycle, the way you want to feel at home, the way you want to mother yourself. Intentions here are quieter than most, tended in privacy and rhythm rather than announced. Care for the container first: the home, the bed, the kitchen, the people who make you feel safe. The caution is the shell. Protecting your feelings is wise, but a shell no one is ever allowed inside stops being protection and starts being loneliness.
sky newmoon sign › capricorn
The Capricorn New Moon is about foundational work. Set ambitious targets and commit to the climb, knowing effort is the price of admission. Structure is the strategy: the plan, the schedule, the immediate next step. When doubt arrives, which is a guarantee under Saturn, use it as useful feedback instead of an obstacle. Ask what it’s actually measuring. Track your physical body, as well, because Capricorn carries unexpressed pressure in the bones and muscles. The main trap is tunnel vision. Feeling stuck is almost always a perspective error before it's an actual dead end.
sky newmoon sign › gemini
A Gemini New Moon plants seeds directly in the mind. Mercury rules this Moon, so anchor your goals in words. Write them out and say them aloud, using clear language to bring order to the chaos. Feed your curiosity deliberately with a course, a reading list, or an unexplored block in your own neighborhood. The main caution is scattering your attention. Ten half-started projects yield less than three tended daily, so focus on the conversations and ideas that actually merit your bandwidth.
sky newmoon sign › leo
A Leo New Moon plants a spark straight into the chest. Lock your intentions to your vision and execute steps, because waiting around to be discovered isn't a strategy. Claim the creative output, the love, and the raw joy that belongs to you. Surround yourself with people who see and accept you, because that emotional security is what allows expression to take root. Launch a project that feels playful and uniquely yours. The main caution is ego-driven noise: unnecessary drama, entitlement, or needing to dominate the space. Shine because it is your natural state, not to extract a handclap.
sky newmoon sign › libra
A Libra New Moon plants seeds in your relationships. Reflect on the balance in each one: are you giving and receiving in fair measure, or bending the truth and swallowing discomfort to keep the peace? Set intentions for harmony that is real, the kind built on honesty instead of your silence. This Moon looks at codependency, trust, old childhood wounds, and power dynamics. For some connections the planting deepens commitment, and for others it starts the honest parting. Plant fairness, in both directions. The caution is losing yourself in the other. A relationship that requires your disappearance is not balance.
sky newmoon sign › pisces
A Pisces New Moon plants seeds in the dream. Set intentions about your inner life: the creative work waiting in you, the intuition you want to trust more, the connection to something larger than the daily grind. Pay attention to your dreams during this Moon and write them down, because the unconscious does real work here. Let yourself be vulnerable with your feelings, alone or with someone trusted, and plant the artistic project that keeps resurfacing. The caution is the fog. Dreaming is the gift, dissolving is the risk, so tie each Pisces intention to one concrete act in the waking world.
sky newmoon sign › sagittarius
A Sagittarius New Moon plants seeds of meaning. Set intentions about the unknown you want to walk into: the trip, the study, the belief you are ready to test against the world. Trust your own intuition over outside approval, and speak your truth with conviction while you plant, because Jupiter expands whatever this Moon touches. That is also the caution: it expands everything, including overcommitment and the escape hatch. Plant one horizon, not five. Gratitude and honesty are the fertilizer here, and the middle of the road deserves the same fire as the start.
sky newmoon sign › scorpio
A Scorpio New Moon plants seeds in the deep. This is the Moon of transformation: face a fear around intimacy, name a pattern you inherited, and let something old finish dying so the new can begin. Mars gives this Moon courage and Pluto gives it depth, and together they hand you raw power to work with. Plant vulnerability on purpose: one truth shared with someone who has earned it. Connect with the ones who came before you if that is part of your practice. The caution is holding the shadows alone. What you face honestly under this Moon transforms. What you keep hidden keeps its grip.
sky newmoon sign › taurus
A Taurus New Moon plants slow-growing seeds: money, foundation, skill, and worth. Set intentions about what you are building, connect with the earth while you do it, and let beauty and nature be part of the practice, because Taurus manifests through the senses. A strong foundation is the intention underneath every other one here. Be patient with the timeline: what this Moon starts is meant to still be standing in years, not weeks. The caution is comfort itself. Do not plant more padding around a life that has stopped fitting.
sky newmoon sign › virgo
A Virgo New Moon plants seeds in the daily round: the habit, the routine, the practice that will still be paying you in six months. Purify first, because Virgo manifests in clean soil: clear the clutter, physical and mental, and release the toxic habit that has been crowding the garden. Set intentions about health, work, and service, and make them small enough to do on an ordinary Tuesday. The caution is perfectionism. The point of the routine is care, not control, and a habit kept imperfectly beats a perfect plan kept never.

sky season lore › aquarius
Aquarius is the eleventh sign, fixed air ruled by Saturn in the ancient system and Uranus in the modern, and its symbol is the water bearer, pouring something out for everyone. It rules deep winter, when survival depends on the group, and it governs community, invention, and the future. The stereotype is the detached one. The older story is the neighbor who carries what the whole village needs and refuses to keep it private.
sky season lore › aries
Aries is the first sign of the zodiac, cardinal fire ruled by Mars, and its symbol is the ram. The zodiac's story starts here, at the spring equinox, when light comes back and everything green pushes up through cold ground. Aries carries that push: the nerve to begin, to want, to go first. The stereotype is the hothead. The older story is the spark that gets the whole wheel turning.
sky season lore › cancer
Cancer is the fourth sign, cardinal water ruled by the Moon, and its symbol is the crab, a soft body inside a strong shell. It begins at the summer solstice, the year's fullest light, and it governs home, memory, and the instinct to protect what is loved. The stereotype is moodiness. The older story is the keeper of the hearth, the one who remembers where everyone came from.
sky season lore › capricorn
Capricorn is the tenth sign, cardinal earth ruled by Saturn, and its symbol is the sea-goat, a climber with a fish's tail, at home in the deep and on the mountain. It begins at the winter solstice, the darkest day, which is exactly when it starts building toward the light. It governs work, mastery, and time. The stereotype is the workaholic. The older story is the elder who builds things that outlive them.
sky season lore › gemini
Gemini is the third sign, mutable air ruled by Mercury, and its symbol is the twins. It sits at the bright, busy end of spring, when everything wants to be met, named, and talked to. Gemini governs language, curiosity, and holding two truths at once. The stereotype is the flake. The older story is the messenger who connects worlds that would not otherwise speak.
sky season lore › leo
Leo is the fifth sign, fixed fire ruled by the Sun, and its symbol is the lion. It rules high summer, when the light is at its most generous and everything ripens in the open. Leo governs the heart, creativity, and the courage to be seen. The stereotype is the show-off. The older story is the sovereign whose warmth makes other people braver.
sky season lore › libra
Libra is the seventh sign, cardinal air ruled by Venus, and its symbol is the scales, the only symbol in the zodiac that is not a living creature. It begins at the autumn equinox, the day light and dark stand equal, and it governs partnership, fairness, and beauty as a form of order. The stereotype is indecision. The older story is the judge who takes every side seriously because the balance actually matters.
sky season lore › pisces
Pisces is the twelfth and last sign, mutable water ruled by Jupiter in the ancient system and Neptune in the modern, and its symbol is two fish swimming in opposite directions, tied together. It rules the end of winter, when the year dissolves before beginning again, and it governs dreams, compassion, and the places where the line between you and everything else gets thin. The stereotype is the escapist. The older story is the mystic who feels the whole ocean and still comes back to shore.
sky season lore › sagittarius
Sagittarius is the ninth sign, mutable fire ruled by Jupiter, and its symbol is the centaur archer, half animal and half philosopher, aiming past the horizon. It rules the darkening end of autumn, when the search for meaning gets serious, and it governs belief, travel, and the long questions. The stereotype is the one who cannot commit. The older story is the teacher who had to wander to have something worth teaching.
sky season lore › scorpio
Scorpio is the eighth sign, fixed water ruled by Mars in the ancient system and Pluto in the modern, and its symbols climb a ladder: scorpion, serpent, eagle. It rules the composting part of autumn, and it governs intimacy, shared resources, and the truths people keep under the floor. The stereotype is the schemer. The older story is the one willing to walk into the underworld and come back changed.
sky season lore › taurus
Taurus is the second sign, fixed earth ruled by Venus, and its symbol is the bull. It arrives in the fullness of spring, when the world is finally warm and worth savoring. Taurus governs the body's pleasures and the patience to build things that last. The stereotype is stubbornness. The older story is the gardener who knows that nothing good grows fast.
sky season lore › virgo
Virgo is the sixth sign, mutable earth ruled by Mercury, and its symbol is the maiden holding a sheaf of wheat. This is the sign of the harvest: the stretch of late summer when the crop gets sorted, what nourishes is kept, and what spoils is composted. That is Virgo's real work, discernment in service of care. The stereotype is the perfectionist with the label maker. The older story is the healer and the craftsperson, the one who loves something enough to tend its details.

This is the season of the heart-centered leader: the Sun rules it and light is love. The season's work is stoking your creative fire, taking your place in the spotlight, and letting your warmth give other people permission to shine.
sky season ritual › libra

sky season ritual › pisces
This is the Mystic's season: Jupiter rules it in the ancient system and Neptune in the modern, Thursday is its day, and the Moon is its card. The season's work is karma and the dream: everything flows, out and in, and the tide teaches.
sky season ritual › sagittarius
This is the Archer's season: Jupiter rules it, Thursday is its day, Temperance is its card, and its affirmation is 'I speak my truth.' The season's work is philosophy and the long view: what you believe, and where it is taking you.
sky season ritual › scorpio
This is the season of Death, the card of transformation: Mars rules it in the ancient system and Pluto in the modern, and Tuesday is its day. The season's work is transformation, intimacy, and connecting with the ones who came before you.
sky season ritual › taurus
This is the Farmer's season: Venus rules it, Friday is its day, the Hierophant is its card, and its affirmation is 'I have self-worth.' The season's work is grounding: returning to the earth, building abundance, and letting worth grow roots.
sky season ritual › virgo
This is the season of the Virgin and the Hermit: Mercury rules it and Wednesday is its day. The season's work is being of service without losing yourself: self-care, healthy boundaries, and preparing to go inward as autumn begins.
sky season shadow › aquarius
Aquarius season's shadow is detachment wearing the costume of freedom. You've been analyzing your feelings instead of feeling them, staying in observer mode, being everyone's interesting friend and nobody's close one.
sky season shadow › aries
Aries season's shadow is confusing adrenaline for aliveness. You've been sprinting from thing to thing, starting arguments just to feel your own pulse, calling the urgency ambition when half of it is escape. Speed is not the same as direction.
sky season shadow › cancer
Cancer season's shadow is care sliding into control. You've been feeding everyone, tracking everyone's moods, and calling it love, when part of it is making sure nobody ever has a reason to leave.
sky season shadow › capricorn
Capricorn season's shadow is achievement becoming identity. You've been climbing on autopilot, saying yes to goals that do not excite you, treating your calendar like a scoreboard.
sky season shadow › gemini
Gemini season's shadow is information turning into noise. You've been collecting opinions instead of forming one, filling every silence with input, knowing a little about everything and sitting with nothing.
sky season shadow › leo
Leo season's shadow is presence collapsing into presentation. You've been documenting the moment instead of being in it, saving your warmth for an audience, checking who watched instead of who showed up.
sky season shadow › libra
Libra season's shadow is harmony bought with self-erasure. You've been agreeing to keep the peace, weighing every word until none of them are yours, keeping everyone comfortable while you quietly go without.
sky season shadow › pisces
Pisces season's shadow is empathy without a boundary. You've been feeling everyone's moods, absorbing feelings that were never yours, treating your own needs like an interruption to everyone else's.
sky season shadow › sagittarius
Sagittarius season's shadow is expansion becoming escape. You've been chasing the next horizon so you do not have to finish the last one, calling restlessness freedom, mistaking motion for growth.
sky season shadow › scorpio
Scorpio season's shadow is intensity becoming a requirement. You've been testing people instead of trusting them, digging for the bottom of everything, treating calm like it must be hiding something.
sky season shadow › taurus
Taurus season's shadow is comfort curdling into stuckness. You've been calling the routine peace, buying small treats instead of making the big change, guarding a life that stopped fitting because at least it is familiar.
sky season shadow › virgo
Virgo season's shadow is optimization becoming obsession. You've been fixing everything within reach, treating rest like a reward you have to earn, using competence to avoid being vulnerable anywhere.
sky sign trap › aquarius
the belief that needing people makes you less free. Independence that cannot accept help is just isolation with better branding.
sky sign trap › aries
the belief that momentum equals meaning. You are allowed to stop moving long enough to check the direction.
sky sign trap › cancer
the belief that if you take care of everyone, someone will finally take care of you. Ask directly instead. The people worth keeping can handle a request.
sky sign trap › capricorn
the belief that you are what you finish. The people who love you are not reading your resume.
sky sign trap › gemini
the belief that more information will settle the question. At some point the answer needs a decision, not another source.
sky sign trap › leo
the belief that being seen is the same as being loved. The people who matter would keep watching with the spotlight off.
sky sign trap › libra
the belief that keeping the peace is the same as keeping the relationship. A relationship that cannot survive your honest sentence was already thinner than it looked.
sky sign trap › pisces
the belief that feeling someone's pain is the same as helping them. Compassion with no boundary drowns the lifeguard.
sky sign trap › sagittarius
the belief that the answer lives somewhere you have not been yet. Sometimes the answer is in the room you keep leaving.
sky sign trap › scorpio
the belief that control is the only safe form of closeness. Letting someone see you unguarded is the risk that actually pays.
sky sign trap › taurus
the belief that comfort now equals safety later. Some of what feels like stability is just furniture you have stopped noticing.
sky sign trap › virgo
the belief that if you could just get organized enough, you would finally feel okay. You do not have to fix everything to deserve rest.

Calendar: phases, void, markers 13 entries

The calendar page: the eight moon phase cards, the void-of-course card, and the solstice and equinox cards.

How it reads in the app (one example)

The high tide of power. Celebrate what arrived, look honestly at what did not, and let the light show you the difference.

moon phase › balsamic
The Rest
The dark before the next seed. Rest on purpose and leave the ground alone; the next cycle is already forming.
moon phase › disseminating
The Sharing
The light starts giving itself away. Tell someone what this cycle taught you; a lesson settles when it is shared.
moon phase › first quarter
The Push
First resistance arrives right on schedule. Adjust the plan, not the intention.
moon phase › full moon
The Harvest
The high tide of power. Celebrate what arrived, look honestly at what did not, and let the light show you the difference.
moon phase › last quarter
The Release
The waning Moon carries things out. Put down what the harvest proved you no longer need.
moon phase › new moon
The Seed
The cycle opens in {{signTitle}}. Plant one intention, small and true; new things grow in the dark first.
moon phase › waxing crescent
The First Step
The seed tests the soil. Take the first visible action on what you planted, however minor it looks.
moon phase › waxing gibbous
The Refinement
Almost there is its own phase. Trim what the goal does not need and let the rest ripen.
moon void
Between its last aspect in {{signTitle}} and its entry into {{nextSignTitle}}, the Moon runs void of course. Momentum is thin in these windows, so finish instead of start: tidy loose ends, rest, and hold the launches and big asks until the Moon lands.
season marker › december solstice
December Solstice
The longest night in the north, and the turning point: from here the light returns, one day at a time. In the south, midsummer blazes. The Sun enters Capricorn and hands the year its structure: rest in the dark, then build toward the light.
season marker › june solstice
June Solstice
The Sun stands still at the top of its climb and enters Cancer. In the north this is the longest day: celebrate, gather, and honor the light at its peak, because from here the days shorten. In the south it is the longest night, the turn back toward light. Cancer takes the season either way: home, feeling, and what you protect.
season marker › march equinox
March Equinox
Day and night stand equal, then the Sun crosses into Aries and the zodiac starts over. In the north this is the spring gate: plant, begin, clear the winter out. In the south it is harvest season, the time to gather and give thanks. Either way the lesson is balance: the whole planet holds the same threshold at once.
season marker › september equinox
September Equinox
Light and dark balance again and the Sun enters Libra. In the north the harvest comes in: gather what you grew, share it, and let go of what the season is done with. In the south, spring opens and the planting begins. Libra holds the door: fairness, partnership, and even measure.

daily body › conjunction › chiron
Old pain sits nearer the skin today than usual. Stop bracing like something's about to go wrong - an old reaction is not a new emergency. Be softer with yourself than feels productive; today the softness is the work.
daily body › conjunction › jupiter
Optimism runs hot today and your yes comes easy. Stop signing future-you up for everything present-you finds exciting. Big feelings about a plan are not the same as a plan. Take the biggest idea and give it one concrete first step. That's how luck gets real.
daily body › conjunction › lilith
The filters are thin today and the true opinions sit right behind your teeth. Stop deciding the honest version is too much before anyone's heard it. Say the real thing in your normal voice; no performance required.
daily body › conjunction › mars
You wake up loaded today: drive, edge, momentum, all of it. Stop spending it on irritation and inbox skirmishes - energy this good deserves a real target. Hit the hardest thing on your list first; the rest rides that win.
daily body › conjunction › mercury
Thoughts arrive faster than sentences today. Stop firing off every draft that crosses your mind. Write the good ones down and let them sit until evening; the keepers survive, the clever ones quietly don't. Say less. Land more.
daily body › conjunction › moon
Everything lands closer to the skin today. Stop scheduling like it's a normal day - feelings this loud want witness, not fixing. Cancel one thing and actually feel it; that empties it faster than powering through.
daily body › conjunction › neptune
Focus goes soft today and the daydreams get vivid. Stop demanding sharp answers from a blurry day - some days are for making and wandering, not deciding. Leave the big calls for tomorrow and make something today instead.
daily body › conjunction › north node
The next chapter taps you on the shoulder today: the skill, the place, the conversation you keep circling. Stop filing it under someday - days like this are the calendar's way of underlining. Take one visible step before midnight. Small counts.
daily body › conjunction › pluto
The deep read is on today: motives, patterns, the real reason under the stated one. Stop using it only on other people. The most useful thing you'll uncover today is your own hidden motive, and it will explain a lot. Look there first. Then decide what changes.
daily body › conjunction › saturn
The sober eye is on today: you see the cracks, the debts, the postponed repairs of your own life. Stop reading clarity as doom - seeing plainly is the first half of fixing. Finish one overdue thing completely. Nothing else tastes like done.
daily body › conjunction › south node
The familiar pulls hard today: old habits, old comforts, an old name floating up. Stop mistaking familiar for right - you left some of that behind for reasons. Visit the memory if you want; just come back.
daily body › conjunction › sun
Today your own name is loud in your head: your plans, your pride, your unfinished business. Stop downplaying what you want just to seem easygoing. Clear desire is not arrogance. It gives people something honest to respond to. Ask for it directly. Today, it lands.
daily body › conjunction › uranus
Routine chafes today and the odd idea keeps coming back. Stop dismissing the strange option before you've actually looked at it. The out-of-character move is sometimes the most accurate one you make all year. Try the different route, the different answer, the different room. Small experiments only.
daily body › conjunction › venus
Your taste is turned all the way up today: people, rooms, plans, everything gets felt as beautiful or wrong. Stop calling it pickiness. Knowing what you actually enjoy is a skill most people never build. Choose one real pleasure on purpose today. Skip the obligatory one.
daily body › house › 1
Attention turns back to yourself today: your body, your wants, your own company. Stop treating self-focus like a guilty pleasure - nobody else can do the being-you part. Take yourself somewhere you like. Notice what you want next.
daily body › house › 10
Career, reputation, and the long climb come into focus today. Stop waiting to be noticed and put the finished thing where people can see it - visibility is a task, not a personality trait. Send the work out today. Let it represent you.
daily body › house › 11
Friends, groups, and the bigger circle pull today. Stop letting the group chat count as showing up - one real appearance beats a month of reactions. Reach out to the friend you keep meaning to. The future has people in it.
daily body › house › 12
Rest, privacy, and the inner rooms ask for time today. Stop confusing invisible with unimportant - recovery is real work with no audience, and the world can run without you for an afternoon. Close the door and let it. You come back clearer.
daily body › house › 2
Money, comfort, and what things are worth sit front of mind today. Stop measuring your worth with someone else's ruler. Enough is a number you get to define. Handle one small money thing and then enjoy something you already own. Both are wealth.
daily body › house › 3
Words, errands, and quick connections fill today: the text, the sibling, the neighbor, the idea. Stop saving your voice for occasions. The passing conversation you almost skip is the one that matters today. Say the thing while it's easy. Small words do big work.
daily body › house › 4
Family, home, and the private life pull at you today. Stop treating home as whatever is left over after work; today it's the main event. Someone under your roof, or in your roots, could use ten real minutes. Give them. Then take ten for yourself.
daily body › house › 5
Play, romance, and making things ask for room today. Stop postponing fun like it's a reward for a finished list - the list never finishes, and joy today is fuel, not dessert. Do one thing purely because you like it. Let it be unproductive.
daily body › house › 6
Routines, health, and the daily round want attention today. Stop despising the boring tasks - they're how a life stays standing, and your body notices being looked after. Fix one small routine today: the meal, the walk, the bedtime. Small fixes outlast big plans.
daily body › house › 7
Partners, close friends, and one-on-one dealings take the front seat today. Stop guessing what the other person thinks - today is built for asking, not mind-reading. Have the two-person conversation. Alone can wait.
daily body › house › 8
Shared money, trust, and the under-the-surface stuff come up today. Stop skating past the topic you both feel sitting there - avoidance is what keeps charging interest. Ask the private question, or answer one honestly.
daily body › house › 9
The far-off calls today: the trip, the course, the idea from outside your circle. Stop shelving curiosity because the timing isn't practical - perspective is a physical thing you get by moving. Learn one new thing or make the plan to go; give curiosity somewhere real to lead.
daily body › opposition › chiron
Someone bumps an old bruise today and the reaction outruns the crime. Stop deciding they did it on purpose before you've asked a single question - old pain borrows new faces. Tell them gently where it landed, without turning the conversation into a courtroom.
daily body › opposition › jupiter
Today somebody's certainty rubs against yours: beliefs, plans, whose version of better wins. Stop trying to convert people who only needed to be heard. Being right in a way nobody can live with is its own kind of wrong. Trade one honest question for one honest answer. That moves more than a speech.
daily body › opposition › lilith
Around someone today, you edit yourself without noticing: softer opinions, smaller wants, a laugh you don't mean. Stop paying for harmony with pieces of yourself. Say one unedited thing today; let the room meet the real version.
daily body › opposition › mars
Someone pushes today and every instinct says push back harder. Stop treating volume as an argument. The person who stays specific wins the room and keeps the relationship. Name the actual issue in one sentence. Then let silence work.
daily body › opposition › mercury
Today conversations run on two scripts: what got said and what got heard. Stop assuming your version is the recording. Repeat back what you think they meant before you answer, and half of today's fights die right there.
daily body › opposition › moon
Someone's needs and yours come due at the same time today. Stop pretending you don't have any so theirs can go first - resentment starts right there and always collects later. Say what you need out loud, once and plainly.
daily body › opposition › neptune
Today you're filling in someone's blanks with your own fears. Stop treating your guess about them as a fact you're being brave about. The story in your head is always more dramatic than the person in front of you. Ask the direct question. Believe the answer.
daily body › opposition › north node
Someone in your life asks more of you today than feels fair. Stop hearing every stretch as criticism. The relationships that grow you rarely feel relaxing while they're doing it. Say yes to the stretch and no to the guilt. Both fit.
daily body › opposition › pluto
A power current runs through one of your connections today: who bends, who decides, who needs whom more. Stop playing chess with someone you actually want on your team. Influence hoarded turns into distance. Say the honest version first, even though going first feels like losing. It isn't.
daily body › opposition › saturn
An obligation to someone weighs extra today. Stop confusing being needed with being trapped. You said yes for reasons that still exist, and if they've stopped existing, that's a conversation, not a resentment. Have it in daylight.
daily body › opposition › south node
An old dynamic knocks today: the familiar role, the familiar argument, the familiar person. Stop auditioning for a part you already outgrew - nostalgia edits out the reasons you left. Be the current version of yourself on purpose today.
daily body › opposition › sun
Someone pushes back today and it lands like a challenge to who you are. Stop defending your whole self when only one opinion is under review - disagreement isn't disloyalty. Hold your ground on the point, not on your pride.
daily body › opposition › uranus
Today you want room and someone reads that as leaving. Stop apologizing for needing air, and don't make them guess what it means. Space asked for plainly is just space; space taken suddenly reads as escape. Say when you're coming back. Then actually come back.
daily body › opposition › venus
Today you want closeness and they want space, or the reverse - the timing's just off. Stop reading the gap as rejection; two people can love each other on different schedules. Say your version without a test attached.
daily body › soft › chiron
The sore spot isn't sore today, just visible. Stop waiting for a crisis to look at it. On calm days you can trace where it came from without falling in. Name it to yourself, or to someone safe. Named things shrink.
daily body › soft › jupiter
Things break your way today - timing, moods, the small yes from the right person - and there's no catch to wait for. Take the meeting, send the ask, buy the ticket. Luck likes a moving target; give it one.
daily body › soft › lilith
The edge sits well today: the blunt joke lands, the true opinion refreshes the room. Stop assuming the filtered version is the safe one. Today people want the real take, and you're the one holding it. Give it warmly. Warm and honest beats polite.
daily body › soft › mars
Energy flows clean today: no friction, no drag, just capacity. Stop spending a day like this on maintenance and errands. Momentum this smooth is for the thing that scares you a little. Start it now, while starting is cheap. Future-you says thanks.
daily body › soft › mercury
Thinking runs clean today: the email writes itself, the point lands, the joke works. Stop spending the clarity on small talk. This is the day for the conversation you've been drafting for weeks. Have it before the window closes. It goes better than rehearsal.
daily body › soft › moon
The mood underneath everything is quietly good today. Stop poking it to check if it's real. Some days you don't have to earn or analyze; they're just gentle. Spend an hour on something purely comforting. No project attached.
daily body › soft › neptune
Imagination runs clearer today: the image sticks, the hunch is worth testing. Stop demanding proof before you make something - make the thing, write the thing, say the strange kind thing. Logic can check the work tomorrow.
daily body › soft › north node
The direction you've been overthinking looks plain today. Stop re-planning what you already planned. The first step has been the same for weeks; today it's cheap. Take it before the doubt refills. Go now.
daily body › soft › pluto
Depth comes easy today: the real conversation feels natural instead of risky. Stop keeping things light out of habit. The question you've been carrying will land gently if you ask it now. Ask it plainly. What surfaces today heals.
daily body › soft › saturn
Discipline comes easy today; the boring thing feels almost pleasant. Stop saving a productive mood for later - moods don't keep. Clear the overdue pile while it's light, then quit on time tonight. Both halves count.
daily body › soft › south node
What you already know how to do carries you today. Stop discounting the abilities that come easily - easy for you is rare for most. Use the old strength on the new problem. Comfort is a tool today, not a trap.
daily body › soft › sun
The day meets you halfway: people cooperate, plans click, your presence lands. Stop saving your best requests for a harder day - ease isn't a trap, it's a window. Ask for the thing you've been sitting on; asking is the part you control.
daily body › soft › uranus
The unexpected runs friendly today: the plan change helps, the stranger's interesting, the wrong turn works out. Stop gripping the original schedule - days like this reward whoever stays loose. Say yes to the odd invitation; the detour is the point today.
daily body › soft › venus
Warmth moves easily today: compliments land, company feels good, small pleasures deliver. Stop rationing the kind word as if kindness runs out. Say the generous thing you usually keep to yourself; let it land without adding a joke.
daily body › square › chiron
Something minor today presses on something old. Stop scolding yourself for still being sensitive there. The size of your reaction points at the age of the bruise, not the size of the problem. Be gentler with yourself than the moment seems to require. That is the medicine.
daily body › square › jupiter
Your appetite is bigger than your calendar today. Stop promising things future-you has to pay for. One real commitment beats five eager almost-yeses, and people remember which ones you kept. Pick the one that matters. Decline the rest kindly.
daily body › square › lilith
Today the things you don't say start leaking out sideways: the tone, the delay, the almost-joke. Stop editing yourself down to whatever the room can handle - unsaid doesn't mean gone. Say the true thing plainly, once, to the person it actually belongs to.
daily body › square › mars
The irritation today is real, but its aim is off. Stop snapping at whoever happens to be closest. Anger with no job picks one at random, and it usually picks someone you love. Move your body, then talk. In that order.
daily body › square › mercury
Today your words run ahead of your patience. Stop rehearsing your comeback while they're still talking - most arguments are just two people waiting for their turn. Listen once, all the way through, and it changes your next sentence.
daily body › square › moon
An old mood turns up today with a brand-new excuse. Stop arguing with yourself about whether you're allowed to feel it - feelings move through faster when nobody puts them on trial. Let it pass before you decide anything it's whispering.
daily body › square › neptune
Today the fog is internal: half-plans, half-feelings, nothing landing. Stop deciding big things inside a mood this blurry. Not every day is for clarity; some are for drifting on purpose. Do the small concrete task in front of you. Clarity comes back on its own.
daily body › square › north node
The thing you keep postponing gets louder on days like this. Stop waiting to feel ready - readiness rarely shows up on schedule. Take the next small step before confidence arrives; starting badly still counts.
daily body › square › pluto
Today you notice every angle and every motive, including your own. Stop gripping situations that were never yours to run. Gripping harder does not make anything safer; it just makes your hands tired. Pick the one thing actually yours to handle. Handle that.
daily body › square › saturn
Today the to-do list reads like a verdict on your character. Stop treating rest as something you have to earn - the work will meet you tomorrow exactly where you left it. Do the one thing that's actually due and let the rest wait.
daily body › square › south node
Today the familiar option looks better than it is. Stop choosing the known thing just because you already know it. Comfort is a fine place to rest and a bad place to live. Do one thing the new way today. Just one.
daily body › square › sun
The gap between who you are and who you planned to be is loudest on days like this. Stop measuring today against the highlight version of yourself. The plan was a sketch, not a contract, and you are allowed to redraw it. Start smaller. Start anyway.
daily body › square › uranus
Restlessness spikes today and starts pricing exits. Stop mistaking boredom for evidence that everything is wrong. The urge to shock your own life passes; what it costs does not. Change one small thing on purpose. Notice the difference.
daily body › square › venus
Today you'll be tempted to keep score: who reached out, who owes who a call. Stop tallying warmth like it runs out. Ask for the time you want directly instead of testing for it - testing always finds the failure it's looking for.

fog note › variant 1
Wait on the decisions that can wait. When one cannot, keep it small, put the terms in writing, leave yourself a way out, and ask someone neutral to look it over.
fog note › variant 2
You do not need to decide everything right now. For the choices that cannot be postponed, lower the risk: make the commitment smaller, keep it reversible, document what was agreed, and get an outside opinion.
fog note › variant 3
Do not make a permanent decision just to end the uncertainty. When action is necessary, take the smallest workable step, keep your options open, and have someone with no stake in the outcome review it.
fog note › variant 4
Delay the choice when you can. When you cannot, do not bet the whole future on one move. Keep the commitment manageable, protect your exit, document the details, and ask someone outside the situation to check your thinking.

lunation higher path › 1
Your higher path here is leading with the unedited version of yourself. Every room you enter honestly gives everyone else permission to drop their edit too.
lunation higher path › 10
Your higher path here is building a public life your private self can stand behind. Alignment like that reads as authority no title can grant.
lunation higher path › 11
Your higher path here is choosing communities that want the real you, and contributing like the future is a group project, because it is.
lunation higher path › 12
Your higher path here is honoring the inner life: rest, reflection, and endings taken seriously. What you integrate quietly becomes wisdom the whole circle draws on.
lunation higher path › 2
Your higher path here is building worth from the inside: valuing your time, your skills, and your standards before anyone else prices them. Security built that way supports more lives than your own.
lunation higher path › 3
Your higher path here is saying true things clearly, especially the kind ones. Your words travel further than you see, so send the ones worth repeating.
lunation higher path › 4
Your higher path here is making home a place that restores you, then letting that groundedness show up everywhere else. People build braver lives from safe foundations, starting with you.
lunation higher path › 5
Your higher path here is creating and enjoying without apology. Joy done openly is contagious; your permission slip becomes other people's too.
lunation higher path › 6
Your higher path here is treating your body and your days as the foundation of everything else you want. Care done consistently turns into capacity, and capacity is how you serve.
lunation higher path › 7
Your higher path here is partnership between whole people: your needs on the table next to theirs. Every honest negotiation you run teaches both sides that love survives truth.
lunation higher path › 8
Your higher path here is intimacy with boundaries and trust with eyes open. Going deep honestly, once, changes what you accept everywhere.
lunation higher path › 9
Your higher path here is living what you actually believe and staying curious about the rest. A working philosophy helps more people than a defended one.
lunation horoscope › eclipse note
This is an eclipse, so this is not a regular lunation for you: chapters in this house close and open on their own schedule. Skip the rituals this time. Watch what shifts, and let it.
lunation horoscope › full
This Full Moon lands in your {{houseOrdinal}} house of {{jurisdiction}}, bringing this part of your life to a head. What has been building here for the last six months shows its results now, ready or not.
lunation horoscope › new
This New Moon lands in your {{houseOrdinal}} house of {{jurisdiction}}, opening a fresh cycle in this part of your life. What you plant here over the next few days grows for six months.

lunation moment › full › 1
That might look like emotions running higher than usual, people noticing you more, or catching a side of yourself you had been hiding. An unexpected change may knock down a pattern you have outgrown. The release comes after the shock.
lunation moment › full › 10
That might look like a career chapter ending or changing direction, an old path you shelved coming back to life, or recognition arriving from somewhere unexpected. If the work no longer fits the person you have become, you find out now.
lunation moment › full › 11
That might look like a friendship ending or changing shape, a disagreement in a group getting loud, or people around you showing what they need before they can say it. Notice who supports the person you are now, not the person you were.
lunation moment › full › 12
That might look like dreams getting loud, grief or an old loss surfacing to be felt, or needing to find yourself again after too many busy weeks. This stretch runs more emotional than usual. Let it move through instead of scheduling over it.
lunation moment › full › 2
That might look like a bill, debt, or budget question demanding attention, or an old family pattern around money surfacing so it can finally change. What you learn about your finances now is information, not a verdict.
lunation moment › full › 3
That might look like clearing up a misunderstanding with a sibling or someone close, or finally seeing a person clearly after months of reading them wrong. Say the direct version. It lands better than the managed one.
lunation moment › full › 4
That might look like family needing more from you, a problem at home that was kept from you coming to the surface, or seeing where you have been enabling someone because saying no felt harder. If someone at home needs real help, this is the moment to get it.
lunation moment › full › 5
That might look like news about a child in your life, recognition for creative work you have been doing quietly, or attention finding you whether you asked for it or not. Being seen is the theme. Let it happen.
lunation moment › full › 6
That might look like your body asking you to slow down, a daily habit showing what it actually costs you, or work stress reaching the point where something has to change. The fix is small and daily, not dramatic.
lunation moment › full › 7
That might look like a long relationship showing whether it has grown with you, old fears of being left rising up, or a partnership question you have been postponing coming due. The important relationships get looked at honestly now and redefined.
lunation moment › full › 8
That might look like old debt resurfacing from an ex, a family member, or a split you thought was settled, or a demanding person testing your limits. The work is boundaries: what you owe, what you are owed, and what you are done carrying.
lunation moment › full › 9
That might look like an unexpected opportunity or chance meeting, a moment of truth that changes how you read a situation, or the push to break a routine that has kept you small. Say yes to the new thing even if the timing looks wrong.
lunation moment › new › 1
That might look like someone calling you selfish for putting yourself first, a plan getting redirected, or a sudden jolt that breaks a pattern you had stopped noticing. Let it. The shake-up clears room for who you are becoming.
lunation moment › new › 10
That might look like wondering whether your job still fits who you are becoming, a promotion or new path opening up, or a step back that is really a regroup. Keep workplace drama and shortcuts out of it. The long goal is the point.
lunation moment › new › 11
That might look like friendships changing, a new group pulling you in, or your community asking for a skill only you have. Someone near you needs an encouraging word, and you may be the only one who notices.
lunation moment › new › 12
That might look like needing more sleep and quiet than usual, old memories or family patterns surfacing to be cleared, or the outside world feeling like too much. Big decisions can wait. Rest is not falling behind.
lunation moment › new › 2
That might look like a deal ready to close, an idea that could turn into money, or several projects asking for your attention at once. Someone with more experience may show up right when you need direction. Take the meeting.
lunation moment › new › 3
That might look like a sibling or neighbor reaching out, a local project that needs your hands, or the push to finally say something out loud. Your words carry more power than you give them credit for.
lunation moment › new › 4
That might look like family needing more from you, changes in your living situation, or your own need for comfort getting louder. Your emotional needs are being renegotiated, and the people at home will feel it too.
lunation moment › new › 5
That might look like love, children, or a creative project moving to the front of your mind, an old hobby calling you back, or doubt about your own worth flaring up. Make something anyway. The doubt quiets when your hands are busy.
lunation moment › new › 6
That might look like your work schedule or health routine changing, stress from overworking catching up with your body, or a new habit finally sticking. Frustration you swallow tends to land in the body, so give it somewhere to go.
lunation moment › new › 7
That might look like a relationship issue that has not been dealt with coming up for a real conversation, or the decision to cut out someone who does not fit your life anymore. Some of what surfaces may sting. It is still a step toward closeness or a clean break.
lunation moment › new › 8
That might look like what felt secure not feeling so secure anymore, shared money needing an honest conversation, or being asked to let go before you know what comes next. The fear of the empty space is part of the process.
lunation moment › new › 9
That might look like an invitation, interview, or trip that seems small but leads somewhere bigger: a new friend, a new path, even a new place to live. If life feels stuck, distance gives you the view.
lunation release › 1
Let go of managing how you come across. Release the version of you built for approval. Shed the reflex to shrink so nobody flinches. As those loosen, showing up gets easier than maintaining the image ever was.
lunation release › 10
Let go of chasing titles that impress people you do not respect. Release the fear of being seen as ambitious. Shed the work that costs more than it pays in every currency but money. As those loosen, your reputation starts matching your actual values.
lunation release › 11
Let go of friendships running on history alone. Release the need to be liked by every room. Shed the futures you are holding onto only because you announced them. As those loosen, your real people and real hopes get room to arrive.
lunation release › 12
Let go of the processing you do alone that never quite finishes. Release the guilt that has outlived its lesson. Shed the habit of disappearing when you need people most. As those loosen, rest starts actually resting you.
lunation release › 2
Let go of measuring your worth by productivity. Release the fear that enough will never arrive. Shed the spending that soothes instead of serves. As those loosen, money starts following what you value instead of what you fear.
lunation release › 3
Let go of saying yes before you check your week. Release the story you repeat about yourself that stopped being true. Shed the scrolling that eats the hours conversation deserves. As those loosen, your words start carrying weight again.
lunation release › 4
Let go of keeping the family peace at your own expense. Release the guilt about outgrowing where you came from. Shed the clutter, physical and emotional, that keeps home from feeling like yours. As those loosen, your foundation starts holding you up again.
lunation release › 5
Let go of saving joy for after the work is done. Release the fear of being seen trying. Shed the belief that your creativity needs to earn its keep. As those loosen, play starts feeding everything else you do.
lunation release › 6
Let go of running on empty and calling it dedication. Release the routine that serves the schedule but not the body. Shed the small daily self-abandonments: skipped meals, skipped walks, skipped rest. As those loosen, your days start working for you instead of on you.
lunation release › 7
Let go of keeping score in your closest relationships. Release the habit of saying it is fine when it is not. Shed the partnership patterns you inherited but never chose. As those loosen, the people who match you get easier to see.
lunation release › 8
Let go of controlling what was never yours to hold. Release the debt-keeping, emotional and financial. Shed the secret you are tired of carrying alone. As those loosen, trust stops feeling like a risk and starts feeling like relief.
lunation release › 9
Let go of beliefs you defend but no longer believe. Release the plan that made sense for a person you have outgrown. Shed the certainty that keeps you from asking better questions. As those loosen, the bigger picture starts drawing itself.
lunation shows › 1
This is the fresh-start house: a new look, a new direction, a rebirth you can feel. It can show up as the urge to change your path, redirect your life, or step out as a newer version of yourself. The shell cracks so that version can emerge.
lunation shows › 10
It can show up as sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction: career takes the front seat. Step back and check the long game, because whatever you pour energy into should align with your values and build toward your future.
lunation shows › 11
It can show up as renewal in your social networks: friendships changing, new communities forming, strength found in numbers. Surround yourself with people who inspire you, and be an active voice in the rooms you choose.
lunation shows › 12
It can show up as the need to tune out the world and tune in: rest, reflection, and hidden parts of the psyche surfacing to be healed. If you have been numbing yourself with busyness, this Moon calls you back to your truth.
lunation shows › 2
It can show up as money moving: reworking finances, revaluing your work, or behind-the-scenes effort finally getting noticed. How much you value yourself shows in what you are manifesting, so honoring your values is the real assignment.
lunation shows › 3
It can show up close to home: conversations with siblings and neighbors, a creative spark, or the pull to lean on your local circle. Support flows both ways right now, so connect with the people who keep your momentum going.
lunation shows › 4
It can show up as emotion asking for maintenance: feelings you have been holding start to build until they get processed. Checking in, feeling it fully, and letting it move through you is the actual work here; you cannot think your way out of emotion.
lunation shows › 5
It can show up as passion returning: an old hobby calling you back, romance warming, a creative project asking for attention. Reintegrating what you love, including the parts of yourself you abandoned along the way, is the point.
lunation shows › 6
It can show up as health and work routines shifting: new information challenges stuck patterns, and a new self-care rhythm wants building. If you have been giving too much, the focus swings back to you; flexibility is the best tool here.
lunation shows › 7
It can show up as relationship issues finally surfacing for resolution, or at least discussion: reciprocity, commitment, and who belongs in your life. What you need from others has to balance with what they can actually give.
lunation shows › 8
It can show up as power dynamics arising for change: trust, intimacy, debts, and shared resources on the table. What you thought gave you security may not anymore, and your deeper inner resources are what pull you through.
lunation shows › 9
It can show up as the pull toward the bigger picture: travel, study, or exploring beliefs to find what resonates as your own. The old map is up for revision, and honest questions serve you better than inherited answers.
node journey › north node

transit house retro overlay › jupiter
Jupiter runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the growth turns inward for a stretch: gains consolidate rather than multiply, and the opportunity that matters circles back for a second look. Develop what you already hold; the expansion resumes on schedule.
friend view
Jupiter runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their growth turns inward for a stretch: gains consolidate rather than multiply, and the opportunity that matters circles back for a second look. The gains develop best from what they already hold; the expansion resumes on schedule.
transit house retro overlay › mars
Mars runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the drive turns inward and doubles back: stalled projects resurface, old frustrations ask to be finished properly, and force works better revised than repeated. Aim the energy at completing what is already open.
friend view
Mars runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their drive turns inward and doubles back: stalled projects resurface, old frustrations ask to be finished properly, and force works better revised than repeated. The energy pays best aimed at what is already open.
transit house retro overlay › mercury
Mercury runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the weeks double back on themselves: messages resurface, plans revise, and the same conversation comes around twice. The second pass is the editing pass; revise rather than redo, and reconfirm anything with a date on it.
friend view
Mercury runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their weeks double back: messages resurface, plans revise, and the same conversation comes around twice. The second pass is the editing pass for them, and anything with a date on it deserves a reconfirm.
transit house retro overlay › saturn
Saturn runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the structures get tested from the inside: commitments come up for review, and the shortcut taken earlier surfaces for proper repair. Rebuild what wobbles; the inspection ends and the building resumes.
friend view
Saturn runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their structures get tested from the inside: commitments come up for review, and the shortcut taken earlier surfaces for proper repair. What wobbles gets rebuilt; the inspection ends and the building resumes.
transit house retro overlay › venus
Venus runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the window reviews instead of previews: old names resurface, tastes get second-guessed, and what you valued last year comes up for reappraisal. Let the reviews finish before making the purchases and promises permanent.
friend view
Venus runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the window reviews instead of previews for them: old names resurface, tastes get second-guessed, and what they valued last year comes up for reappraisal. The purchases and promises hold better made after the reviews finish.
